fact: ANIP says the IFU is issued from the same national civil-status database as the national identity card.
The government guide says individuals apply for the 13-digit IFU taxpayer number exclusively on the online platform ifu.impots.bj, with a certificate downloadable on approval.
The guide says sole traders and companies being created are registered for the IFU at the business formalities one-stop shop (GUFE) of APIEx.
The DGI guide says a person can register for tax online on the e-services portal and the IFU number is generated instantly.
The DGI guide says the applicant enters their NPI and birth date and personal data is retrieved automatically from ANIP before the IFU is issued.
